name: pi-agent-events-pydantic
description: Import and re-export pi's AgentSessionEvent type tree from a pinned pi version.
comment_versions: Pin all three @earendil-works packages to the EXACT pi version whose stdout you want to model. AgentSessionEvent (pi-coding-agent) pulls AgentEvent/AgentMessage (pi-agent-core) and content blocks/Model (pi-ai); keeping the three aligned keeps the type tree internally consistent.
